{
  "query": "entity",
  "matches": [
    {
      "name": "entity.spawn",
      "category": "world",
      "purpose": "Create a new Entity without a Sprite.",
      "when_to_use": "When a game object must be created dynamically at runtime.",
      "when_not_to_use": "For objects that always exist in the scene, prefer putting them in the scene source.",
      "parameters": [
        {
          "name": "name",
          "type_name": "string",
          "meaning": "The Entity display name and base name for its id."
        }
      ],
      "returns": "string: the unique Entity id that was created.",
      "side_effects": [
        "Modify Rust-owned world state"
      ],
      "frame_semantics": "The Entity can be used immediately in the same script update; its id remains valid until the world is rebuilt.",
      "common_errors": [
        "An empty name uses entity",
        "A duplicate name receives a suffix such as _2 or _3"
      ],
      "example": "local id = api.entity.spawn(\"enemy\")",
      "related_apis": [
        "entity.getPosition",
        "entity.setPosition"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "entity.despawn",
      "category": "world",
      "purpose": "Remove an Entity and all of its components.",
      "when_to_use": "When an object is defeated, destroyed, or leaves the level.",
      "when_not_to_use": "Do not replace removal with moving the object off-screen: its rigid body still participates in collisions and still consumes a physics integration.",
      "parameters": [
        {
          "name": "id",
          "type_name": "string",
          "meaning": "The Entity id to remove."
        }
      ],
      "returns": "(): no additional data on success.",
      "side_effects": [
        "Modify Rust-owned world state"
      ],
      "frame_semantics": "Takes effect immediately in the same update; contacts for that Entity in the current frame are removed as well.",
      "common_errors": [
        "The Entity does not exist"
      ],
      "example": "api.entity.despawn(\"pig_a\")",
      "related_apis": [
        "entity.spawn",
        "entity.setSpriteVisible"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "entity.setSpriteVisible",

      "when_not_to_use": "This does not affect collisions: an invisible rigid body still collides. Use entity.despawn for complete removal.",
      "parameters": [
        {
          "name": "id",
          "type_name": "string",
          "meaning": "The target Entity id."
        },
        {
          "name": "visible",
          "type_name": "boolean",
          "meaning": "true to show, false to hide."
        }
      ],
      "returns": "(): no additional data on success.",
      "side_effects": [
        "Modify Rust-owned world state"
      ],
      "frame_semantics": "The next observation reflects the new value in sprite.visible.",
      "common_errors": [
        "The Entity does not exist",
        "The Entity has no Sprite"
      ],
      "example": "api.entity.setSpriteVisible(\"pig_a\", false)",
      "related_apis": [
        "entity.despawn"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "entity.getPosition",

      "when_to_use": "When game rules need to use the current position.",
      "when_not_to_use": "Do not use it in place of scene or prefab source data.",
      "parameters": [
        {
          "name": "id",
          "type_name": "string",
          "meaning": "An existing Entity id."
        }
      ],
      "returns": "Vec2: x and y values of type number.",
      "side_effects": [
        "Read Rust-owned world state"
      ],
      "frame_semantics": "Returns the current value from the start of this update; a read after setPosition reflects the new value on the next read.",
      "common_errors": [
        "A missing Entity id returns LUAU_RUNTIME_ERROR"
      ],
      "example": "local position = api.entity.getPosition(\"player\")",

        "entity.setPosition"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "entity.setPosition",

      "when_not_to_use": "Do not maintain a second Transform in each game; that makes observations and rendering disagree.",
      "parameters": [
        {
          "name": "id",
          "type_name": "string",
          "meaning": "An existing Entity id."
        },
        {
          "name": "position",

        "Modify Rust-owned world state"
      ],
      "frame_semantics": "The update takes effect immediately during the current script call; the world frame increments only after the update completes.",
      "common_errors": [
        "A missing Entity id returns LUAU_RUNTIME_ERROR",
        "x/y must be numbers"

      "example": "api.entity.setPosition(\"player\", { x = 1, y = 0 })",
      "related_apis": [
        "entity.getPosition",
        "entity.spawn"
      ]
    },
    {

        {

          "meaning": "An existing Entity id."

        "Read Rust-owned 2D world state"

        "A missing Entity id returns LUAU_RUNTIME_ERROR"

      "example": "local transform = api.entity.getTransform2D(\"bird\")",

        "entity.setTransform2D",
        "entity.getPosition"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "entity.setTransform2D",

      "when_not_to_use": "Do not use visual scale to change the collider; RigidBody2D radius, mass, velocity, and contact logic remain independent.",
      "parameters": [
        {
          "name": "id",
          "type_name": "string",
          "meaning": "An existing Entity id."
        },
        {
          "name": "transform",
          "type_name": "Transform2D",
          "meaning": "A complete position and rotation with scale x/y greater than 0."
        }
      ],
      "returns": "(): no additional data on success.",
      "side_effects": [
        "Modify Rust-owned 2D visual/world state"

      "frame_semantics": "The update takes effect immediately during the current script update; the renderer reads the new visual state from the snapshot, while physics does not read rotation or scale.",

        "A missing Entity id returns LUAU_RUNTIME_ERROR",

        "scale x/y must be greater than 0"

      "example": "api.entity.setTransform2D(\"bird\", { position = { x = 1, y = 2 }, rotation = 0.5, scale = { x = 1.2, y = 0.8 } })",
      "related_apis": [
        "entity.getTransform2D",
        "entity.setPosition"
      ]
    },

          "meaning": "An Entity id with a Transform3D."

        "A missing Entity id returns LUAU_RUNTIME_ERROR",

        "entity.setTransform3D",

    {

      "name": "observation.array",
